day_local: ULwesine Weveki Yamashumi Amathathu Ananye KwiXesha Eliqhelekileyo
greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNdodana, nelikaMoya Oyingcwele. Makube noxolo nalo lonke uthando oluvela kuThixo uBawo nakuyo iNkosi uYesu Kristu kini nonke.
penitential:
Nkosi, yiba nenceba kuthi.
Kristu, yiba nenceba kuthi.
Nkosi, yiba nenceba kuthi.
homily:
Cinga ngendlela umntu olahlekelwe yinto ethile ebalulekileyo aphosa ngayo amehlo akhe kuyo yonke indawo, ekhangela ekhoneni ngalinye, engadinwa de afumane oko bekulahlekile. Akukho nqaku lobomi elilula ngokwaneleyo ukuba lishiywe emva xa into enjalo ishiywe endleleni.

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje evela kuLuka, uYesu usibonisa lo mfanekiso. Uthi: 'Ngumuphi umntu phakathi kwenu onezimvu ezilikhulu, alahlekelwe yinye yazo, ongayishiyiyo le mifu ibonakala ilungileyo entlango, aye emva kwaleyo ilahlekileyo de ayifumane?' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… uYesu akathethi nje ngezilwanyana. Uthetha ngesiphelo somntu ngamnye kuthi. Uthetha ngothando olungadinwayo, olukhangelayo, olungayekiyo de lufikelele kulowo ulahlekileyo.

UBenjamin Vo wayengumfana owayezazi kakuhle izinto zokuqonda indlela ehamba ngayo enqondweni nasemhlabeni. Khumbula indlela awayethanda ngayo ukudala nokucinga ngezinto ezinkulu, indlela awayephila ngayo ngobuhle bokucinga ngeendiza, nangala mava amnandi awayewenza nobawo wakhe xa babesenza iindawo zokubukela iinqwelo-moya, ehlekisa ngale ndlela imnandi ye-'con chim airlines' awayeyila entloko yakhe. UBen wayengumfana owayenenhliziyo ethambileyo, owayebonisa ububele obungagungqiyo. Wayengumntwana owayesebenzisa ingqondo yakhe eqaqambileyo ukuzisa ukukhanya kubantu abamngqongileyo, kodwa ngaphezu kwako konke, wayeneentliziyo eyayazi ukuba kuthetha ukuthini ukuthanda ngenene.

Kodwa masiyimele inyaniso namhlanje ngaphambi kokuba siye phambili. Alan noThao, nawe Ryan mfowethu omncane, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane minne idlulileyo ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, iintlungu ziza ngamanye amaxesha ngendlela embi kakhulu, zikushiya ungazi nokuba ume ngaphi. Kukho amandla emphefumlo aphelileyo, kukho ubusuku obude lapho ukungabikho kwesitulo sikaBen okanye ukungaphulaphuli kwakhe amabanga ayethethwa nguyise kubangela isikhewu esingazalisekiyo. Kukho amaxesha apho ukuziva usodwa kuhlasela ngaphandle kwesaziso, kwaye umthwalo wokulahlekelwa uba nzima kakhulu ukuba ungathwalwa.

Mamela le nyaniso namhlanje, mhlawumbi ngendlela odinga ngayo ukuyiva ngoku: uThixo akamlibalanga uBen, kwaye akakubalelanga nani. Kwizinto ezenzekayo ebudeni bokugula kwabantwana, abazali abaninzi bazithwala ngokwabo umthwalo onzima kakhulu wokuzisola: 'Ngaba kukhona endinokukwenza ngcono? Ngaba ndiphosile?' Mamele kakuhle, Alan noThao: uThixo akakubeki icala. UBen akakubeki icala. Ezo zifo aziziswanga zizinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. Kweli hlabathi, kukho izinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lomntu, ngaphandle kwempazamo yomzali. Awuphosanga nto. Uthando lwakho lwalucocekile, lwaluphelele, kwaye uBen wayesazi ukuba unothando olungaka kubazali bakhe nakuRyan. Khipha elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje. UBen akajongi iziphoso; ujonge phezulu kuThixo, kwaye uqhubeka esithi kuwe: 'Ba, Mama, musani ukukhala kakhulu, ndikhuselekile.'

KwiNcwadi kaPawulos kwabaseFilipi namhlanje, uPawulos usixelela into enzulu kakhulu ngendlela esijonga ngayo ubomi: 'Kodwa nokuba yintoni eyayisiba yinzuzo kum, ndiyibala njengelahleko ngenxa kaKristu. Ngaphezu koko, ndiyazibala zonke izinto njengelahleko ngenxa yobukhulu bokumazi uKristu Jesus iNkosi yam.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… UPawulos akathethi ngokuphulukana nezinto zenyama ngendlela ebolileyo. Uthetha ngokuphulukana nezinto ezingento ngezinto zikaThixo ezinqabileyo. UBen wayenaleyo mfanekiso entliziyweni yakhe. Wayengumfana owayengaphili nje ngezinto zeli hlabathi, kodwa owayezimisele ukunika konke okwakhe ngenxa yabanye. Khumbula lowo mzuzu apho uBen, esemncinci kakhulu, wayefuna ukunikela ngemali yakhe yasebhange encinci ukunceda umalume wakhe uWilliam owayehlaselwe zizifo. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube, akazange ayikhuphule imali leyo, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe: umntwana owayeselula kodwa onentliziyo enkulu eyayifuna ukunceda wonke umntu ngaphandle kokucingela yena.

Ryan, mfowethu okhoyo apha, ndifuna uthathe oku nawe. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakhe. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade. Xa uziva usodwa, khumbula ukuba uBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo.

Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando olungapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo sesidlo sasezulwini, lapho indlu kaThixo izele khona ngabantu abavela kude nakufi, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu Kristu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukho kwiSakramente eliCileyo leAltare. Ndikuthanda ngaphezu kwazo zonke izinto, kwaye ndinqwenela ukuba nawe emphefumlweni wam. Njengoko ndingenako ngoku ukwamkela kwiSakramente, nceda uze emphefumlweni wam ngendlela yomoya nangobabalo lwakho. Ndiyakwamkela njengokuba sele ukhona phakathi kwam, ndize ndibopheleleke kuwe ngokuphelele; musa ukuvumela ukuba ndahlulwe nawe naphakade. Amen.
closing: Makube yinkosi yethu uYesu Kristu ekukhapheni kuyo yonke imihla, kwaye uthando lukaThixo uBawo lubonakale ezintliziyweni zenu nonke namhlanje naphakade. Amen.
standing_petitions: Ukuze uBenjamin oselula kunye nabo bonke abashiye eli hlabathi baphumle ekukhanyeni kukaKristu okungapheliyo, sikhuleka kuThixo.
Ukuze bonke abasentslungwini yokulahlekelwa banikwe uThixo amandla, ithemba, nentuthuzelo engapheliyo, sikhuleka kuThixo.

readings.label: ISIFUNDO SOKUQALA
readings.text: Bazalwana, thina singabake yamkelayo ukwaluswa, thina abakhonzayo ngoMoya kaThixo, abaziqhenyayo ngoKristu Yesu, nabangazithembiyo ezinyameni, nangona mna ngokwam ndinezigxina zokuzithemba nasezinyameni. Ukuba kukho omnye ocinga ukuba angazithemba ezinyameni, mna ndingaphezu kwakhe. Ndayaluswa ngosuku lwesibhozo, ndingowohlanga luka-Israyeli, owesizwe sakwaBenjamin, umHebheyu ozalwa ngamaHebheyu; ngokuphathelene nomthetho ndiyiFarisi, ngokuphathelene nomona ndiye ndalitshutshisa ibandla, ngokuphathelene nobulungisa obusemthethweni ndandingenasiphoso. Kodwa izinto ezaziyinzuzo kum, ezi zinto ndizibalileyo njengelahleko ngenxa kaKristu. Ngaphezu koko, ndizibala zonke izinto njengelahleko ngenxa yobukhulu bokumazi uKristu Jesus iNkosi yam.

readings.label: IHUBO LOKUPHENDULA
readings.text:
Mayivuye intliziyo yabo abamfunayo uYehova.
Culani kuye, mculeleni iindumiso, xelani zonke izimanga zakhe. Qhayisani ngegama lakhe eliyingcwele; mayivuye intliziyo yabo abamfunayo uYehova!
Khangelani kuYehova nasemandleni akhe; funani ubuso bakhe amaxesha onke. Khumbulani izimanga azenzileyo, imiqondiso yakhe, nezigwebo zomlomo wakhe.
Nzala ka-Abraham okhonzi wakhe, nyana bakaJakobi banyulwa bakhe! NguYehova uThixo wethu; izigwebo zakhe zisezweni lonke.

readings.label: IVANGELI
readings.text: Babeze bonke abaphuli-mthetho nabona-zoni ukuba bamphulaphule uYesu. AbaFarisi nababhali bakrokra besithi, 'Lo mntu wamkela abona-zoni, adle nabo.' Wababulelela ke lo mzekelo esithi: 'Ngumuphi umntu phakathi kwenu onezimvu ezilikhulu, alahlekelwe yinye yazo, ongayishiyiyo le milili ilishumi elinesithoba entlango, aye emva kwaleyo ilahlekileyo de ayifumane? Xa ayifumeneyo, uyibeka emaxhebeni akhe enemihlali, afike ekhaya abize abahlobo bakhe nabamelwane, athi kubo, "Vuyani nam, kuba ndiyifumene imvu yam elahlekileyo." Ndithi kuni, kuya kuba njalo, kuya kubakho uvuyo ezulwini ngomona-zoni mnye oguqukayo, kunezigidi ezimashumi alithoba anesithoba ezingamalungisa ezingaswele nguquko. Ekanye ngumuphi umfana onamashumi ezingxowa zemali, alahlekelwe yinye yazo, ongayikhanyisiyo isibane, ayisele indlu, ayifune ngenyameko de ayifumane? Xa ayifumeneyo, abiza abahlobo bakhe nabamelwane, athi kubo, "Vuyani nam, kuba ndiyifumene ingxowa yemali endiyilahlekisileyo." Ndithi kuni, kuya kuba njalo, kuya kubakho uvuyo phambi ko㎜ezulu ngegosa linye oguqukayo.'

day: Thursday of the Thirty-first Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.
